svg.title: Zagotovka-M architecture: a wired home and Zigbee devices around an STM32 controller
svg.desc: Wired switches, buttons, lamps, outlets and sensors connect directly to the Zagotovka-M STM32 controller (89 physical pins, 200 Zigbee pins, one web interface). The controller also offers SMS and DTMF control and talks MQTT to a single-board computer that runs Zigbee2MQTT, an MQTT broker and Home Assistant. A Zigbee coordinator, connected by LAN or USB, links Zigbee lamps, buttons and sensors.
